//! A `derive` — an attribute macro that rewrites the item it decorates,
//! and a rewrite this parse cannot see.

fn base_s() -> i64 {
    std::time::SystemTime::now()
        .duration_since(std::time::UNIX_EPOCH)
        .expect("clock")
        .as_secs() as i64
}

#[derive(Debug)]
struct Marker;
